page.title: How ForFuture works
page.subtitle: ForFuture helps young people turn concerns, ideas, and community needs into organized civic action.
page.accountBody: Anyone can browse public movements, polls, relief campaigns, the Impact Map, and Inspire Hub as a guest. Creating an account unlocks following, signing, voting, volunteering, commenting, and creating your own movements.
page.featuresHeading: What you can do on ForFuture
page.demoNote: These examples help visitors understand how ForFuture works. They are demo examples, not live user data.

discover.title: Discover
discover.description: Explore public movements, petitions, polls, volunteer drives, and relief needs shared by the community.

join.title: Join
join.description: Create an account to follow movements, sign petitions, vote in polls, volunteer, and support causes.

actionPath.title: ActionPath AI
actionPath.headline: Turn a rough thought into a clear movement.
actionPath.helper: Describe your idea, concern, or community problem in simple words. ActionPath AI will suggest the best type of movement, improve your message, and recommend practical next steps.
actionPath.placeholder: Example: The road near our school is unsafe because there is no crossing and many students walk there every day.
actionPath.trustNote: AI suggestions are a starting point. Review and edit before publishing.
actionPath.languageNote: ActionPath AI replies in the language of your input when possible; otherwise English.
actionPath.typeSwitchNote: Using this draft will switch your movement type to the recommendation above.
actionPath.reliefRedirectNote: Donation & Relief requests use a dedicated form. “Use This Draft” will open the Relief Hub create flow with your AI draft prefilled.
actionPath.errorGeneric: ActionPath AI could not generate a suggestion. Please try again.
actionPath.errorBusy: ActionPath AI is busy at the moment. Please try again shortly.
actionPath.errorTimeout: This is taking longer than expected. Please try again.
actionPath.errorUnavailable: ActionPath AI is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
actionPath.errorMalformed: ActionPath AI could not generate a suggestion. Please try again.
actionPath.errorAuth: Sign in to use ActionPath AI.
actionPath.errorConfig: ActionPath AI is warming up. Please try again in a moment.
actionPath.errorRetryHint: Wait a moment, then try once more.
actionPath.validationTooShort: Please describe your concern in more detail.
actionPath.validationTooLong: Please keep your idea under {{max}} characters.
actionPath.validationGibberish: This looks too short or unclear. Try writing one sentence about the problem.
actionPath.validationUnclear: Please describe a real issue, idea, or community concern.
actionPath.validationBeforeGenerate: Please describe a real community issue or idea before generating an Action Path.
actionPath.authMessage: Create an account to shape ideas with ActionPath AI and turn your thoughts into civic action.
